crash_recovery_scenarios.failure_mode: Client submits duplicate key while previous order is in-flight or filled
crash_recovery_scenarios.storage_state: Registry contains COMMITTED or active RESERVED record
crash_recovery_scenarios.recovery_behavior: reserve_order_slot() rejects duplicate order immediately without state changes

crash_recovery_scenarios.failure_mode: Process crashes or throws unhandled exception during SQLite INSERT transaction
crash_recovery_scenarios.recovery_behavior: SQLite WAL rollback automatically purges uncommitted record; on restart, no phantom reservation exists

crash_recovery_scenarios.failure_mode: Limit price not reached, zero fill, or margin check fails
crash_recovery_scenarios.storage_state: Registry has RESERVED record; broker calls release_order_reservation()
crash_recovery_scenarios.recovery_behavior: Status transitions to RELEASED; slot is cleared for subsequent orders; retry permitted if authorized

crash_recovery_scenarios.failure_mode: Worker dies or experiences network lag exceeding lease TTL (30s)
crash_recovery_scenarios.storage_state: Registry record status is RESERVED with now_epoch >= expires_at
crash_recovery_scenarios.recovery_behavior: Subsequent worker detects expired lease, clears stale reservation, and claims slot with incremented generation

crash_recovery_scenarios.failure_mode: Order filled and COMMITTED to SQLite + JSON, but client dies before receiving response
crash_recovery_scenarios.storage_state: Registry has COMMITTED status; JSON state has open_position
crash_recovery_scenarios.recovery_behavior: Client retries with same idempotency_key on restart; registry rejects as duplicate COMMITTED order, preventing double execution

crash_recovery_scenarios.failure_mode: 1,005 subsequent orders fill, dropping original key from in-memory FIFO dictionary
crash_recovery_scenarios.storage_state: Original key absent from _processed_idempotency_keys, but present as COMMITTED in SQLite and closed_trades
crash_recovery_scenarios.recovery_behavior: L2 check in SQLite registry intercepts request and deterministically rejects duplicate

crash_recovery_scenarios.failure_mode: Massive trading volume (>10,000 trades) followed by restart and replay of historical key
crash_recovery_scenarios.recovery_behavior: Indexed B-tree lookup instantly matches primary key and blocks re-execution

crash_recovery_scenarios.failure_mode: Underlying SQLite database file corrupted with garbage bytes or zeroed headers
crash_recovery_scenarios.recovery_behavior: Registry isolates damaged DB to .corrupt.<timestamp>, initializes fresh schema, and backfills historical trade IDs from closed_trades; duplicate keys remain blocked

crash_recovery_scenarios.failure_mode: Process crashes hard (os._exit) while holding portalocker OS file lock
crash_recovery_scenarios.storage_state: Lock file handle open in terminated process
crash_recovery_scenarios.recovery_behavior: Operating system kernel automatically frees file descriptor locks upon process termination; next process acquires lock immediately without deadlock

crash_recovery_scenarios.failure_mode: Order filled, position closed via TP/SL, account is flat; rogue client replays key
crash_recovery_scenarios.storage_state: open_position is None, key is COMMITTED in SQLite and recorded in closed_trades
crash_recovery_scenarios.recovery_behavior: Durable registry blocks re-execution permanently; ledger remains intact
